context: Tests whether the agent correctly applies LLVM 22 migration changes: replacing legacy pass manager with NPM, fixing opaque pointer APIs, updating deprecated headers, replacing llvm::Optional with std::optional, and using getOrInsertDeclaration instead of removed getDeclaration.

checklist.name: Legacy PM removed from StatsPass
checklist.description: StatsPass no longer inherits from FunctionPass. Instead uses PassInfoMixin<StatsPass> with a run(Function&, FunctionAnalysisManager&) method returning PreservedAnalyses

checklist.name: No legacy PM in main.cpp
checklist.description: main.cpp does NOT use legacy::PassManager, PM.add(), or PM.run(). Custom pass invoked via NPM (ModulePassManager or FunctionPassManager with PassBuilder)

checklist.name: llvm::Optional replaced
checklist.description: All uses of llvm::Optional<T> replaced with std::optional<T>, and llvm::None replaced with std::nullopt. llvm/ADT/Optional.h header removed.

checklist.name: Intrinsic::getDeclaration replaced
checklist.description: Intrinsic::getDeclaration() replaced with Intrinsic::getOrInsertDeclaration() or Intrinsic::getDeclarationIfExists()

checklist.name: Opaque pointer API fixed
checklist.description: getFloatPtrTy() (or equivalent) no longer uses ->getPointerTo(). Uses PointerType::get(Ctx, 0) or Builder.getPtrTy() instead

checklist.name: Triple.h include path updated
checklist.description: Include of llvm/ADT/Triple.h updated to llvm/TargetParser/Triple.h

checklist.name: Host.h include path updated
checklist.description: Include of llvm/Support/Host.h updated to llvm/TargetParser/Host.h

checklist.name: CMake LLVM version bumped
checklist.description: CMakeLists.txt changes find_package(LLVM 18 ...) to find_package(LLVM 22 REQUIRED CONFIG)

checklist.name: No using namespace llvm in header
checklist.description: StatsPass.h does NOT contain 'using namespace llvm' at file scope

checklist.name: MIGRATION.md lists changes
checklist.description: MIGRATION.md file is present and lists at least 4 of the changes made with reasons
